nightly-tag-opt.goal:
Optimize tag_nationality_historical.py to maximize leads processed per minute. Current baseline is 50 leads per batch with 4.1s sleep. 
1. Use gemini-3-flash-preview. 
2. Implement concurrent API calls (e.g. 5 parallel threads) with a shared rate limiter to stay under 15 RPM. 
3. Increase BATCH_SIZE to 100. 
4. Implement a background thread for database writes so classification doesn't block on I/O.
5. Benchmark the new version for 5 minutes and report the final leads-per-minute. 
Use --permission-mode bypassPermissions internally.
